scope: Pre-League Legendary Titan ruins: Regirock / Regice / Registeel + Regigigas activation loop
design_source: Pokemon Platinum / Sinnoh ruins and seven-dot statue puzzles, adapted only where required to satisfy Mercury pre-League availability
source_rule: Platinum/Sinnoh defines each ruin room, puzzle, legendary identity, and story landmark. Emerald-derived engine content is not a design source.

unlock.trigger: After earning the Icicle Badge, Snowpoint Temple becomes explorable before the League. Reaching dormant Regigigas on B5F activates the Titan Tablet story flag.
unlock.titan_tablet: Mercury key-story device replacing Platinum's external/fateful-encounter Regigigas requirement. It activates the seven-dot patterns/statues in all three ruins without requiring an event Pokemon.
unlock.why: Avoids Platinum's circular/event-only access while preserving the original three ruin puzzles and Regigigas requirement.

ROCK_PEAK_RUINS.platinum_identity: Use the Platinum Rock Peak Ruins room, seven floor dots, rear statue, Hard Stone flavor/reward, and Regirock encounter behavior.
ROCK_PEAK_RUINS.mercury_access: The ruin chamber is accessed pre-League from a newly uncovered branch of the Route 214 Ruin Maniac Tunnel rather than requiring postgame Route 228. Only the entrance connection changes; the Rock Peak Ruins room/puzzle remains Platinum-derived.
ROCK_PEAK_RUINS.activation: Titan Tablet active -> step on all seven dots -> tremor -> interact with statue.
ROCK_PEAK_RUINS.respawn: If KOed or fled, Regirock returns after leaving/re-entering the ruin until caught.

ICEBERG_RUINS.platinum_identity: Keep the Platinum Iceberg Ruins inside northern Mt. Coronet near the Route 216 exit, including the seven-dot floor puzzle and statue.
ICEBERG_RUINS.mercury_access: Available pre-League once the Titan Tablet is active; no Hall of Fame, National Dex, or external event Regigigas.
ICEBERG_RUINS.activation: Titan Tablet active -> step on all seven dots -> tremor -> interact with statue.
ICEBERG_RUINS.respawn: If KOed or fled, Regice returns after leaving/re-entering the ruin until caught.

IRON_RUINS.platinum_identity: Keep the Platinum Iron Ruins on Iron Island near the exit, including the seven-dot floor puzzle and statue.
IRON_RUINS.mercury_access: Available pre-League once the Titan Tablet is active; Iron Island remains the canonical location.
IRON_RUINS.activation: Titan Tablet active -> step on all seven dots -> tremor -> interact with statue.
IRON_RUINS.respawn: If KOed or fled, Registeel returns after leaving/re-entering the ruin until caught.

regigigas.requirement: Regirock, Regice, and Registeel must all be in the party.
regigigas.platinum_identity: Preserve Platinum's Level 1 Regigigas gimmick and Snowpoint Temple location.
regigigas.mercury_access: No National Dex or Hall of Fame requirement. Once the trio is caught, return to B5F and interact with dormant Regigigas.
regigigas.respawn: If KOed or fled, Regigigas remains available after leaving/re-entering B5F until caught.

implementation_rules: Do not add generic random encounters inside any of the three Titan Ruins.
Do not open Route 228/Battle Zone early merely to reach Regirock.
Do not require an external event Regigigas, Pal Park transfer, or National Dex.
Use a dedicated story flag/key-item state for Titan Tablet activation; exact item constant may be allocated during final map/script implementation.
Legendary catches are once-per-save after successful capture, but KO/flee must never permanently lose them.
The Regi trio and Regigigas are all obtainable before the Pokemon League.
